NUTTY BRANCH - a RetroStone VC game for Windows
(c) 2026 Pierre-Louis Boyer (8BCraft). Code MIT, art/music/sound CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: see LICENSE-nuttybranch.txt.

A red squirrel races along an endless oak branch, the branch rushing at you like
an arcade road. The branch is round: the further you run from the top, the harder
gravity pulls you off the side. Keep your balance, jump twigs, gaps and
caterpillars, dodge webs, woodpecker holes and pinecones, and lean out for the
nuts as far as you dare. Medals at 250, 500, 1000 and 1500 m; your best distance
is kept.

Run NuttyBranch.exe. No installation needed (SDL2 is built in).

Controls                  Gamepad (SNES layout)      Keyboard
  steer round the branch    D-pad Left / Right         arrows
  jump (hold: higher)       A (or B)                   X (or Z)
  start                     A (Left / Right too)       X, arrows or Enter
  pause / resume            Select (or Start)          Backspace or Enter
  players 2-4 join          A on their pad, on the title (B leaves)
  back to the title         A on the game-over panel

Up to four squirrels race on the same branch, each with their own pad: the
last one standing wins.

F11 or Alt+Enter: fullscreen. F12: screenshot. Close the window to quit.
Options: NuttyBranch.exe --scale 4 --fullscreen
The best distance and score are saved in nuttybranch.srm next to the exe.
